_meta.purpose: Realistic WO templates for Embraer E-Jet (E170/E175/E190/E195 + E2 variants) MRO operations. Parallel to workorders_real.json (A32x) and workorders_real_B737.json (Boeing).
_meta.generationMethod: Per-chapter quotas weighted by real line/base maintenance frequency for E-Jet (regional jet, simpler than narrow-body Airbus/Boeing). Severity calibrated to ~70% Minor / 25% Major / 5% Critical. Deferrable rate calibrated to ~35%. Engine-specific WOs (CF34-8E / CF34-10E / PW1900G) tagged in chapters 71-80 where applicable.
sources: FAA MMEL Embraer EMB-170/190 (public, current revision) — https://drs.faa.gov/browse/MMEL/doctypeDetails
FAA MMEL Embraer EMB-190-E2 (public, current revision)
AD ANAC 2018-12-01 (E190 fuselage frame fwd cargo bay inspection)
AD FAA 2020-26-12 (E170/175/190/195 NLG shock strut piston tube replacement)
AD EASA 2022-0084 (E190-E2 GTF gearbox bearing inspection)
Aircraft Commerce: E-Jet engine on-wing maintenance CF34-8E/10E (Issue 87, 2013)
Honeywell Primus Epic public technical overviews
Pratt & Whitney GTF service bulletin tracker (PW1900G)
_meta.schemaNotes: engineSpecific: null when applicable to all engine variants; otherwise one of CF34-8E (E170/E175), CF34-10E (E190/E195), PW1900G (E190-E2/E195-E2). melCategory: null for non-deferrable items. Part numbers use placeholders (P/N EJ-XXX-XXXX, P/N EMB-XXXX) — never real OEM P/Ns.

templates.title: A-Check task card 200 — flight control surface visual inspection
templates.description: Per AMM 05-20 A-Check package: visual inspection of all primary flight control surfaces for cracks, dents, paint damage, hinge wear, trailing edge condition. Document findings in tech log.

templates.title: A-Check task card 305 — landing gear walk-around inspection
templates.description: Detailed visual of MLG/NLG: tire wear and pressure, brake wear pin extension, oleo extension, no leaks at retract actuator and door uplock. Sign off task card.

templates.title: Daily Check — log book review and CMC status check
templates.description: Review aircraft tech log, status messages from Honeywell CMC (Central Maintenance Computer), MEL deferred items list and confirm rectification interval not exceeded. Clear non-impacting CMC messages per AMM 31-32.

templates.title: Weekly Check — operational test of cockpit/cabin emergency equipment
templates.description: Function test cockpit emergency lights, exit signs, slide arming positions, fire bottle pressure indications, oxygen mask drops simulated test per AMM 05-50.

templates.title: Towing event — gear pin install/remove and brake pressurization check
templates.description: Install MLG/NLG ground locks for tow, confirm Sys 2 hyd pressure for parking brake, walk-around clearance check.

templates.title: Tug coupling damage — inspect NLG towbar fitting
templates.description: Following towing incident report: inspect NLG towbar attach point for cracks, deformation. Dye penetrant if any indication. Per AMM 09-10.

templates.title: Storage preparation — engine and APU preservation 7-day
templates.description: Apply preservation procedure to engines and APU per AMM 10-13 for short-term storage: oil system fogging, intake/exhaust covers, pitot covers, gear pin install.

templates.title: Return to service — post-storage system tests
templates.description: Remove preservation, run engine motoring, full hydraulic Sys 1 / Sys 2 and pneumatic checks, refuel and water service. Confirm CMC clean.

templates.title: Replace fuselage exit door placard (faded)
templates.description: Replace ARM/DISARM and OPEN sequence placard adjacent to door 1L per IPC. Check adhesive cure time.

templates.title: Repaint walkway markings on horizontal stab
templates.description: Touch up red walkway markings per livery std. Surface prep, mask, apply two coats of polyurethane paint.

templates.title: Daily oil top-up — engine #1 (CF34-8E or 10E)
templates.description: Top up engine #1 oil per AMM 12-13. Check sight glass post-flight (within 30 min of shutdown). Log quantity added.

templates.title: Daily oil top-up — engine #2 (CF34-8E or 10E)
templates.description: Top up engine #2 oil per AMM 12-13. Same procedure as engine #1. Trend monitor consumption.

templates.title: APU oil top-up (Honeywell 36-150)
templates.description: Check and top up APU oil per AMM 12-15. Honeywell 36-150 specific procedure.

templates.title: Hydraulic reservoir top-up — Sys 1
templates.description: Top up Sys 1 hyd reservoir with Skydrol LD-4 per AMM 12-12. Check level via sight gauge in nose bay.

templates.title: Hydraulic reservoir top-up — Sys 2
templates.description: Top up Sys 2 hyd reservoir with Skydrol LD-4 per AMM 12-12. Sys 2 reservoir located in aft cargo bay.

templates.title: Tire pressure check — all main and nose wheels
templates.description: Check tire pressure per AMM 12-14. Adjust per ambient temperature chart. E-Jet has 2 NLG tires + 4 MLG tires.

templates.title: Potable water service
templates.description: Drain, sanitize and refill potable water tank per AMM 12-32. E-Jet tank capacity ~150L.

templates.title: Lavatory waste tank service
templates.description: Drain waste tanks (typically 2 lavs E-Jet), flush with vacuum waste service truck.

templates.title: Pack Flow Control Valve R/R — pack 1
templates.description: Pack 1 FCV faulted (CMC fault PACK 1 FCV). R/R per AMM 21-26. Functional test and pressure test post-install.

templates.title: Recirculation fan replacement (one of two)
templates.description: Recirc fan #1 noisy, vibration trend exceeds limits. R/R fan per AMM 21-52. MEL Cat C deferral if not replaced same day.

templates.title: Trim air valve overhaul — fwd cabin zone
templates.description: Trim air valve fwd zone stuck. R/R per AMM 21-43. Functional test all zones.

templates.title: Cabin pressure leak troubleshooting
templates.description: Cabin altitude diff trending high. Smoke test per AMM 21-31; check door seals, outflow valve, pack outflow ducts.

templates.title: Outflow valve actuator R/R — pressurization fail in cruise
templates.description: Outflow valve runaway in cruise, emergency descent. AOG: R/R actuator per AMM 21-31. Function test pressurization both channels.

templates.title: Pack 2 ACM (Air Cycle Machine) bearing replacement
templates.description: ACM pack 2 vibration high (CMC trend). R/R bearing kit per AMM 21-50. Bench test pack post-install.

templates.title: CPCS (Cabin Pressure Control System) channel reset
templates.description: CPCS channel A faulted at altitude. CMC reset, BITE check, line replaceable per AMM 21-31. If recurring, R/R controller.

templates.title: Air conditioning duct insulation repair
templates.description: Cabin reports cold draft row 12. Inspect duct, repair foam insulation per SRM 21-21.

templates.title: Pack temperature sensor R/R
templates.description: Pack 1 temp sensor faulted (CMC). R/R sensor per AMM 21-61. Check wiring continuity.

templates.title: Autopilot disconnect troubleshooting
templates.description: AP1 disconnects intermittently in cruise. CMC fault history download, check yaw damper interface. Per AMM 22-10. May need AP servo R/R.

templates.title: Autothrottle servo R/R — engine #2
templates.description: AT servo engine #2 sluggish response. R/R servo per AMM 22-32. Functional test post-install.

templates.title: Yaw damper actuator R/R
templates.description: Yaw damper inop, CMC fault. R/R actuator per AMM 22-50.

templates.title: VHF 2 transceiver R/R
templates.description: VHF 2 weak transmission. R/R transceiver in E-bay per AMM 23-12. Range test post-install.

templates.title: ACARS message failure investigation
templates.description: ACARS uplink failures reported. CMC fault download, verify VHF datalink path, check ATSU. Per AMM 23-23.

templates.title: CVR (Cockpit Voice Recorder) functional test
templates.description: Annual CVR functional test per AMM 23-71. Quality check recording, time stamp, area mic.

templates.title: Cockpit audio panel R/R — captain side
templates.description: Captain audio panel intermittent. R/R panel per AMM 23-50.

templates.title: IDG #1 runaway during TO — emergency disconnect
templates.description: IDG #1 runaway during takeoff, emergency electrical reconfig. AOG: R/R IDG per AMM 24-21. Check engine accessory gearbox interface for chips. Inspect downstream electrical buses.

templates.title: APU generator output low
templates.description: APU GEN trips offline at idle. R/R generator per AMM 24-22. Check exciter and voltage regulator.

templates.title: Main battery #1 capacity check failed — replace
templates.description: Battery #1 capacity check below 80% per AMM 24-32. R/R battery, dispose per HazMat.

templates.title: TRU (Transformer Rectifier Unit) #2 R/R
templates.description: TRU 2 output low, CMC fault ELEC TRU 2. R/R unit per AMM 24-30.

templates.title: Static inverter functional test
templates.description: Quarterly static inverter test per AMM 24-58.

templates.title: RAT deployment functional test
templates.description: Annual RAT deployment test per AMM 24-50. Manual deploy, check generator output, retract and re-stow.

templates.title: GCU (Generator Control Unit) #1 R/R
templates.description: GCU 1 fault (CMC). R/R per AMM 24-21. BITE test post-install.

templates.title: External power receptacle inspection
templates.description: Visual inspection of external power receptacle pins for arcing/burn marks. Per AMM 24-41.

templates.title: Pax seat 14C — recline mechanism inop
templates.description: Seat 14C recline broken, deferral via Cat D placard. Order seat parts.

templates.title: Cabin attendant jumpseat harness R/R
templates.description: FA jumpseat harness frayed. R/R per AMM 25-25.

templates.title: Galley oven 1L electrical fault — R/R
templates.description: Fwd galley oven trips breaker. R/R oven per AMM 25-31.

templates.title: Lavatory door latch repair — fwd lav
templates.description: Lav door OCCUPIED indicator stuck. R/R latch assy per AMM 25-40.

templates.title: Cabin overhead bin latch R/R
templates.description: Overhead bin row 8 latch broken. R/R per IPC 25-23.

templates.title: Cargo net replacement — fwd compartment
templates.description: Fwd cargo net torn. R/R per AMM 25-50.

templates.title: ELT battery replacement (5-year interval)
templates.description: Fixed ELT battery time-life expired. R/R battery per AMM 25-65.

templates.title: Slide pack R/R — door 1L (10-year overhaul)
templates.description: Slide pack reached 10-year overhaul interval. Send to repair station, install replacement per AMM 25-66.

templates.title: Engine fire detection loop A — continuity test
templates.description: Annual continuity test of engine fire loop A both engines per AMM 26-11.

templates.title: APU fire detection loop fault — R/R
templates.description: APU fire loop intermittent fault. R/R loop per AMM 26-15. Continuity test post-install.

templates.title: Lavatory smoke detector R/R
templates.description: Aft lav smoke detector failed self-test. R/R per AMM 26-22.

templates.title: Engine fire bottle hydrostatic test (5-year)
templates.description: Engine fire bottle reached 5-year interval. Remove, ship for hydrostatic test, install replacement.

templates.title: Cargo compartment smoke detector functional test
templates.description: Annual functional test cargo smoke detectors per AMM 26-23.

templates.title: FCM (Flight Control Module) #1 reset
templates.description: FCM 1 BITE flag in CMC. Reset per AMM 27-22, monitor recurrence. R/R if persistent.

templates.title: FCM #2 R/R after persistent fault
templates.description: FCM 2 fault recurring after reset. R/R unit per AMM 27-22. Reconfiguration post-install.

templates.title: Aileron cable tension adjustment (E1 mechanical aileron)
templates.description: Aileron cable tension out of limits per AMM 27-11. Adjust turnbuckle, verify with tensiometer. Specific to E1 (E2 is FBW).

templates.title: Flap PCU (Power Control Unit) leak
templates.description: Hyd Skydrol leak at flap PCU. R/R seal kit per AMM 27-50.

templates.title: Multifunction spoiler actuator R/R — LH outboard
templates.description: MFS LH outboard inop. R/R actuator per AMM 27-60. Rigging check post-install.

templates.title: Elevator FBW transducer fault
templates.description: Elevator position transducer faulted (CMC). R/R per AMM 27-30.

templates.title: Rudder PCU servo valve R/R
templates.description: Rudder slow response. R/R PCU servo per AMM 27-20.

templates.title: Slat asymmetry sensor R/R (E2 only)
templates.description: E2 slat asymmetry sensor faulted. R/R per E2 AMM 27-80. Applicable only to E190-E2/E195-E2.

templates.title: Wing tank boost pump R/R — LH inboard
templates.description: Boost pump LH inboard low pressure warning. R/R per AMM 28-22. Functional test, leak check.

templates.title: FQI (Fuel Quantity Indication) channel calibration
templates.description: FQI channel drift per CMC report. Recalibrate per AMM 28-41.

templates.title: Fuel crossfeed valve R/R
templates.description: Crossfeed valve fault (CMC). R/R per AMM 28-31. Functional test fuel balance procedure.

templates.title: Refuel coupling leak repair
templates.description: Pressure refuel coupling leaks during refuel. R/R seal per AMM 28-46.

templates.title: Fuel tank sealant repair — wing dry bay leak (AOG)
templates.description: Active fuel leak from wing dry bay LH detected on apron. AOG: defuel, tank entry, locate seam, R&R sealant per SRM 28-11. Cure time 24h. Aircraft grounded until pressure test passes.

templates.title: Fuel temperature sensor R/R — wing tank
templates.description: Wing tank fuel temp sensor faulted. R/R per AMM 28-42.

templates.title: Fuel pump connector arcing — clean and inspect
templates.description: Inspection found arcing on fuel pump connector. Per SB EMB-28-0042 inspect/clean per procedure.

templates.title: Center wing tank vent valve inspection
templates.description: Vent valve binding check per AMM 28-13. Lubricate/replace as required.

templates.title: Sys 1 EDP R/R — leak at case
templates.description: Sys 1 EDP leaking at pump case. R/R EDP per AMM 29-11. Hyd flush and bleed post-install.

templates.title: Sys 2 EDP R/R — pressure low
templates.description: Sys 2 EDP output pressure below limits. R/R per AMM 29-12. Pressure test post-install.

templates.title: Hydraulic filter R/R — Sys 1 case drain
templates.description: Sys 1 case drain filter clogged warning (CMC). R/R filter per AMM 29-15. Inspect for metallic contamination.

templates.title: PTU electric motor brushes inspection
templates.description: Annual inspection of PTU electric motor brushes per AMM 29-21. R/R if worn.

templates.title: Sys 2 AC electric pump R/R
templates.description: Sys 2 AC electric pump fails to maintain pressure. R/R per AMM 29-13.

templates.title: Hydraulic accumulator nitrogen recharge
templates.description: Sys 1 accumulator nitrogen pressure low. Recharge per AMM 29-31.

templates.title: Hydraulic reservoir level sensor R/R
templates.description: Sys 1 reservoir level sensor faulted (CMC false low warning). R/R sensor per AMM 29-10.

templates.title: Sys 1 EDP failure during taxi — AOG
templates.description: EDP Sys 1 catastrophic failure during pushback, fluid spray. AOG: contain leak, R/R EDP, flush system, replenish 8L Skydrol. Inspect downstream filters for debris.

templates.title: Wing anti-ice valve R/R — LH
templates.description: WAI valve LH stuck closed. R/R per AMM 30-11. Functional test ground.

templates.title: Engine cowl anti-ice valve R/R
templates.description: Engine #1 cowl AI valve fault. R/R per AMM 30-21.

templates.title: Pitot probe heater R/R — captain side
templates.description: Captain pitot heat fault. R/R probe per AMM 30-31.

templates.title: Windshield wiper motor R/R — F/O side
templates.description: F/O wiper inop. R/R motor per AMM 30-42.

templates.title: AOA probe heater functional test
templates.description: Annual functional test AOA probe heaters per AMM 30-31.

templates.title: Primus Epic MFD #2 swap
templates.description: MFD 2 display flicker. Swap with MFD 4 (rotation per AMM 31-50). Order replacement.

templates.title: EICAS DU R/R
templates.description: EICAS DU dim. R/R per AMM 31-60. Reconfiguration test post-install.

templates.title: MAU (Modular Avionics Unit) module R/R
templates.description: MAU module fault (CMC). R/R module per AMM 31-40. Honeywell Primus Epic specific procedure.

templates.title: DFDR download for incident review
templates.description: Pull DFDR per safety request. Download data, copy to media, return DFDR to service. Per AMM 31-31.

templates.title: Cockpit clock/chronometer replacement
templates.description: Cockpit clock display dim. R/R per AMM 31-25.

templates.title: Tire change MLG outboard LH — wear limits
templates.description: MLG outboard LH tire below wear limit. R/R per AMM 32-43. Torque check, leak test.

templates.title: Brake assembly R/R MLG — wear pin extended
templates.description: MLG brake wear pin extended below limit. R/R brake assy per AMM 32-44. Bleed brake hyd line.

templates.title: BCM (Brake Control Module) channel A reset
templates.description: BCM channel A faulted. CMC reset, BITE check per AMM 32-44.

templates.title: Anti-skid valve R/R — MLG inboard RH
templates.description: Anti-skid fault one wheel (CMC). R/R valve per AMM 32-42.

templates.title: NWS (Nose Wheel Steering) actuator fluid leak
templates.description: NWS actuator leaking Skydrol. R/R seal kit per AMM 32-51.

templates.title: AD FAA 2020-26-12 — NLG shock strut piston tube R/R (compliance overdue)
templates.description: Per AD FAA 2020-26-12 (E170/175/190/195): replace NLG shock strut piston tube per service bulletin EMB-32-0089. AD compliance overdue, aircraft grounded until done.

templates.title: MLG retract actuator hyd leak
templates.description: MLG retract actuator leaking. R/R seal per AMM 32-32.

templates.title: Gear position WOW (Weight on Wheels) sensor R/R
templates.description: WOW sensor MLG faulted (CMC false ground/air). R/R sensor per AMM 32-71.

templates.title: Brake temperature monitor channel R/R
templates.description: Brake temp indication one channel inop. R/R sensor per AMM 32-31.

templates.title: MLG oleo servicing — N2 and Skydrol charge
templates.description: MLG oleo extension below limits. Charge with N2 and Skydrol per AMM 32-11.

templates.title: Landing light bulb R/R — LH
templates.description: LH landing light burnt. R/R bulb per AMM 33-21.

templates.title: Strobe light R/R — wingtip RH
templates.description: RH wingtip strobe inop. R/R per AMM 33-44.

templates.title: Cabin emergency light battery pack R/R
templates.description: Battery pack fault. R/R per AMM 33-51. 3-year time-life applies.

templates.title: Cockpit dome light R/R
templates.description: Captain dome light bulb burnt. R/R per IPC 33-12.

templates.title: Logo light R/R — vertical stab
templates.description: Vertical stab logo light inop. R/R per AMM 33-45.

templates.title: Nav light position lens replacement
templates.description: Nav light lens cracked. R/R per AMM 33-43.

templates.title: AHRS #1 reset and BITE check
templates.description: AHRS 1 alignment issue. CMC reset per AMM 34-11. If recurring, R/R AHRS unit.

templates.title: ADC (Air Data Computer) #1 R/R
templates.description: ADC 1 faulted, RVSM impacted. R/R per AMM 34-12.

templates.title: Weather radar R/T R/R
templates.description: WX radar inop. R/R R/T unit in nose per AMM 34-43. Nose radome removal required.

templates.title: TCAS computer R/R
templates.description: TCAS fault (CMC). R/R computer per AMM 34-45.

templates.title: EGPWS terrain database update
templates.description: EGPWS terrain database AIRAC cycle update per AMM 34-46. Honeywell EGPWS specific.

templates.title: FMS NavDB (Honeywell EFIS-NAV-3000) AIRAC update
templates.description: 28-day AIRAC update for FMS nav database per AMM 34-61.

templates.title: Transponder #1 R/R
templates.description: XPDR 1 fault. R/R per AMM 34-57. RVSM verification required.

templates.title: GPS receiver R/R
templates.description: GPS receiver intermittent. R/R per AMM 34-58.

templates.title: Crew O2 cylinder pressure check
templates.description: Daily crew O2 cylinder pressure check per AMM 35-11. Top-up if below limit.

templates.title: Pax O2 generator row 8 R/R — expired
templates.description: Pax O2 generators row 8 reached 12-yr life. R/R per AMM 35-21. HazMat handling.

templates.title: Portable O2 bottle hydrostatic test
templates.description: Portable bottle 5-yr hydro test. Remove, ship, install replacement.

templates.title: Engine bleed valve R/R — engine #2
templates.description: Engine 2 bleed valve fault. R/R per AMM 36-11. Pressure test post-install.

templates.title: Crossbleed valve actuator R/R
templates.description: Crossbleed valve actuator fault. R/R per AMM 36-12.

templates.title: Pneumatic leak detection loop R/R
templates.description: Pneumatic leak loop fault. R/R per AMM 36-21. Continuity test.

templates.title: Precooler outlet temp sensor R/R
templates.description: Precooler outlet temp sensor faulted. R/R per AMM 36-13.

templates.title: Potable water tank leak inspection
templates.description: Cabin reports water under galley. Inspect potable tank lines, seals per AMM 38-11. Repair as required.

templates.title: Lavatory vacuum waste flush valve R/R
templates.description: Aft lav flush valve stuck. R/R per AMM 38-32.

templates.title: Potable water heater element R/R
templates.description: Galley water heater fails to heat. R/R element per AMM 38-13.

templates.title: Cabin PA amplifier R/R
templates.description: Cabin PA garbled. R/R amplifier per AMM 44-21.

templates.title: Cabin interphone station R/R — fwd
templates.description: Fwd FA interphone station inop. R/R per AMM 44-31.

templates.title: Pax info sign (No Smoking / Seat Belt) ballast R/R
templates.description: Sign row 6 not illuminating. R/R ballast per AMM 44-12.

templates.title: CMC (Central Maintenance Computer) post-flight report download
templates.description: Daily CMC fault download from Honeywell CMC, review for new faults, dispatch impact assessment per AMM 45-10.

templates.title: CMC module R/R after persistent fault
templates.description: CMC module faulted, BITE flag persistent. R/R module per AMM 45-11.

templates.title: APU starter generator R/R (Honeywell 36-150)
templates.description: APU SG fault, slow start trend. R/R per AMM 49-41. Honeywell 36-150 specific.

templates.title: APU FCU (Fuel Control Unit) R/R
templates.description: APU FCU fault. R/R per AMM 49-31.

templates.title: APU bleed valve R/R
templates.description: APU bleed valve fault. R/R per AMM 49-22.

templates.title: APU oil filter R/R
templates.description: APU oil filter scheduled R/R per AMM 49-90. Inspect for metallic content.

templates.title: APU ECU (Electronic Control Unit) reset
templates.description: APU ECU faulted, BITE check. Reset per AMM 49-60.

templates.title: APU exhaust EGT overtemp shutdown — investigation
templates.description: APU shutdown on EGT overtemp. Borescope inspection of APU turbine, check thermocouple, replace if degraded.

templates.title: Corrosion control program — CPCP zone 5 inspection
templates.description: Quarterly CPCP zone 5 (lower fuselage) inspection per AMM 51-30.

templates.title: Pax door 2L slide arming pin replacement
templates.description: Slide arming pin worn, replace per AMM 52-12.

templates.title: Cargo door indication switch R/R
templates.description: Aft cargo door indication shows 'open' on closed door. R/R proximity sensor per AMM 52-71.

templates.title: Door 1R seal replacement — air leak
templates.description: Pax door 1R seal worn, audible leak in cruise. R/R seal per AMM 52-11.

templates.title: Lightning strike inspection — fuselage skin
templates.description: Following crew report of lightning strike: visual inspection of fuselage skin for burn marks, exit/entry holes per AMM 53-10. SRM repair if found.

templates.title: AD ANAC 2018-12-01 — fwd cargo bay frame inspection
templates.description: Per AD ANAC 2018-12-01 (E190): inspect fwd cargo bay frames for cracks per service bulletin EMB-53-0079. Repetitive inspection 1500 FC.

templates.title: Engine fan cowl latch inspection
templates.description: Pre-flight finding: fan cowl latch indicator. Inspect latches both engines per AMM 54-22.

templates.title: Horizontal stab leading edge inspection
templates.description: Annual visual inspection horizontal stab LE for erosion, paint damage per AMM 55-10.

templates.title: Cockpit windshield heat element R/R — captain
templates.description: Captain windshield heat fault. R/R element per AMM 56-11.

templates.title: Cabin window pane crack — R/R
templates.description: Cabin window row 5 outer pane cracked. R/R window assy per AMM 56-21.

templates.title: Winglet inspection — visual + bond integrity
templates.description: Walk-around finding: chip on winglet leading edge. Inspect bond per SRM 57-30. Touch-up paint.

templates.title: Engine drain mast R/R — corrosion (CF34-8E)
templates.description: Engine drain mast corroded on CF34-8E. R/R mast per AMM 71-71.

templates.title: Engine quick access cowl seal R/R
templates.description: Cowl seal aged, allowing rain ingress. R/R seal per AMM 71-12.

templates.title: Borescope inspection HPC — CF34-8E routine
templates.description: Per GE TASK 72-31-00: HPC borescope inspection on CF34-8E. Document blade condition. Engine on-wing inspection.

templates.title: Borescope inspection HPT — CF34-10E
templates.description: CF34-10E HPT borescope per GE EM. Check NSG blade condition; AD compliance check.

templates.description: Per AD EASA 2022-0084 (E190-E2 PW1900G): inspect GTF gearbox journal bearings per P&W SB. AD compliance.

templates.description: FADEC channel A fault (CMC) on E170/E175. Reset per AMM 73-22. CF34-8E specific BITE procedure.

templates.description: HMU fault on CF34-10E (E190/E195), fuel scheduling issue. R/R per AMM 73-21.

templates.description: Ignition exciter fault on CF34-10E. R/R per AMM 74-31.

templates.description: VBV actuator fault on CF34-10E, surge margin reduced. R/R per AMM 75-31.

templates.description: N1 vibration channel inop. R/R sensor per AMM 77-11.

templates.description: EGT thermocouple drift on CF34-10E. R/R per AMM 77-21.
